title: Turn signed low-order coefficients into a positive warmBstate and a common recovery benchmark
statement: The receiving proof bounds canonical radius, strong BUSY count and raw energy for one signed low-order endpoint expansion. A positive CP/TNI compression close to logical identity times a signed auxiliary factor admits a positive warm replacement extracted using one fixed logical state, with dimension-independent error cost. The actual warm-memory and future BUSY clauses yield one common correctable bare-B DATA span. The SAME ordinary zero-code recovery works with retained records/bath correlations. No physical reencoder, frame inverse, auxiliary independence or rare-record normalization is inserted.

requires: Encoded Q and qualified raw Bell target/gauge source with clean admitted apparatus at one common waiting start.
Distinct AB rollback/FIFO and Q/new-B idempotent machines; distinct old/new B auxiliaries and tags; actual CNOT, Bell readout, carrier, Pauli endpoint and finite resets.
Paid O(N) parallel measured-bit bandwidth, pointwise bounded-body incident joint-cb noise, normal CPTP propagators and complete-loss compressions.
Fixed/exogenous access and future ordinary zero-code DATA recovery; auxiliary states may be correlated but are independent of the unknown logical input.
